Rina K.: hey all — Rina here, joined platform team last week. I'm scheduled for my first oncall week next Tue but can't reach the bastion (ssh times out) and PagerDuty shows 'not eligible'. Who should I ping? :wave:

Oscar V.: welcome Rina! :tada: For PD eligibility file the oncall-access form (https://wiki.internal/access-requests -> oncall-eligibility). For bastion, open a ticket to infra-jumphosts or DM me your github handle and I'll add your pubkey for a 24h window.

Rina K.: filed the form, req OKTA-8442. GitHub handle rinak. Also getting a 403 when opening /runbooks/index.md — is that a separate permission?

InfraBot: Okta sync initiated for user "Rina K." -> group "platform-oncall" (audit id: c3d2). Runbook repo permission: pending approval from runbook-owners team.

Maya H.: I own the runbook team — gave you read access a minute ago, you should get an email. We keep edit rights locked until after two shadow rotations. Feel free to submit PRs for typos; we'll review.

Oscar V.: Okta sync should finish within 10m. Once you show eligible I'll add you to the PD schedule. Meanwhile I'll add your pubkey to bastion for 24h — check again in 2 minutes.

InfraBot: Okta sync complete: user "Rina K." added to group "platform-oncall" (audit id: c3d2). Bastion ACL updated: pubkey added for user "rinak" (expires in 24h).

Rina K.: got the PD test and the bastion SSH works now. Thanks! Quick Q: what's expected during shadow sessions?

Maya H.: we do two 2-hour shadows: first is observation + runbook walkthrough, second is handling pages with shadow watching; then one supervised solo. Use the sim channel (#eng-oncall-sim) for practice pages. Follow incident-lifecycle.md for triage and always open a timeline entry.

OncallBot: Assigned checklist to Rina K.: read runbooks, run PD test, complete 2 sims, attend 2 shadow sessions. Due: 4 days.

Rina K.: perfect — appreciate the fast help. I'll schedule the shadow slots and start the sims. :rocket:
